notes.title: 10000+ wishlists
notes.content: [p]Thank you all! Development is in full swing, and I hope to release a demo version of the game by the end of the year for everyone who wants to try it out. Creating a server-based game turned out to be a very difficult task that differs greatly from a single-player game in terms of logic building. I've learned a lot about creating server code and basically have a good understanding of how to put the game together. The only problem is that it takes a lot of time... The full version will be released in 2026. Sorry.[/p]
